root_cause.text: The dw_i3c_master_i2c_xfers() function fails to free the previously allocated xfer structure when pm_runtime_resume_and_get() returns an error, resulting in a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a `dw_i3c_master_free_xfer(xfer)` call in the error path after the `pm_runtime_resume_and_get()` failure check, as shown in the diff at drivers/i3c/master/dw-i3c-master.c line 1109. The commit message explicitly states: "If pm_runtime_resume_and_get() fails, the function returns without freeing the allocated xfer, resulting in a memory leak."
